headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Chicago Cubs 8-4 behind a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy, who pitched 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture, while Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, Matt Chapman, Trevor McDonald, and Garrett Whitlock are also on the injured list with various injuries.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded from the Athletics for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, sending Ornelas to the Brewers. The Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a player-to-be-named-later deal.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters while allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 1-4 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Webb pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. This move comes as a result of an update to his status.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added infield depth with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
